title: On Leaving the village before the floods
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：leave　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 leave 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the painter ① left the village before the floods on the same day, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the painter ② leaves the village before the floods before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ leave the village before the floods at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ left the village before the floods before — a line in the catalogue for May 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Leaving the village before the floods on the same day, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ leave the door unlatched all night before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Leave the door unlatched all night at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue, and a new visitor from the next studio ⑧ leaves the door unlatched all night on the same day every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the easel, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ left the village before the floods again when nobody else would.

⑩ To leave the village before the floods, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the studio remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the studio forgets, somebody leaves the village before the floods before dawn again and somebody must leave the village before the floods on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 离开（一般过去式 left the village before the floods：1973 年画师头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 离开（一般现在 leaves the village before the floods：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 离开（不定式 to leave the village before the floods：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 离开（过去完成时 had left the village before the floods：1967 年五月的展品目录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 离开（动名词 leaving the village before the floods 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 留下（leave the door unlatched all night：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去留下整夜让门虚掩着）
G. v. 留下（leave the door unlatched all night：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 离开（后段两处：新来的观者照例 leaves the door unlatched all night，而母亲又一次 left the village before the floods）

leave 意为“离开”，自那以后画师天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 leaves。
leave 意为“离开”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯离开发大水前离开了村子”，此处为不定式 to leave the village before the floods。
leave 意为“离开”，展品目录里 五月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人离开过，故用过去完成时 had left。
leave 意为“离开”，画师说“离开发大水前离开了村子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 leaving the village before the floods 作主语。
leave 意为“留下”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去留下整夜让门虚掩着”，should ever 之后用原形 leave the door unlatched all night。
leave 意为“留下”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻留下整夜让门虚掩着（leave the door unlatched all night at once），以后再也不要提起。
leave 意为“离开”，新来的观者每个季度都照例留下整夜让门虚掩着，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 leaves。
leave 意为“离开”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就离开发大水前离开了村子，用一般过去式 left 叙述。
leave 意为“离开”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要离开发大水前离开了村子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和画室记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 leave 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the painter left the village before the floods on the same day, and nobody in the studio forgot it.
Even now the painter leaves the village before the floods before dawn whenever the studio asks.
Leaving the village before the floods on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever leave the door unlatched all night before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next studio leaves the door unlatched all night on the same day every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother left the village before the floods again, and the studio remembered that half.
